_about: Measured simulation, not applied. A temporary copy of the repository TUF data had the proposal from tuf1_nsac_audit_2026-09-13.json applied to its tuf-1.json (commission result_sources, commission classification basis with ESPN and record absence as corroboration, fight_date, commission method/time); scripts/tuf/completeness_matrix.mjs then ran against that copy with read-only database selects. The repository data was not changed.

remaining_blocker.rule: completeness_matrix.mjs counts every entry in a season _conflicts list as an open source conflict, including a timeline episode-placement conflict that touches no result or classification. Under the current bar TUF 1 therefore stays PARTIAL and the hub stays Format complete + Research gaps. Treating placement conflicts as non-blocking would be a change to the generic bar, out of scope here.
